defs.def: aware of and able to understand other people and their feelings 体贴的；体恤的；善解人意的
able to understand art, music and literature and to express yourself through them 感觉敏锐的；艺术感觉好的；有悟性的
easily offended or upset 易生气的；易被惹恼的；神经过敏的
that you have to treat with great care because it may offend people or make them angry or embarrassed 须谨慎对待的；敏感的

ex.s: We might not enjoy these jokes as much as the people who first heard them did, but the authors understood that humour could help people understand sensitive or emotional issues as well as make them laugh.
ex.t: 我们可能不像最初听到这些笑话的人那样喜欢这些笑话，但作者理解幽默可以帮助人们理解敏感或情感问题，并让他们笑起来。

ex.s: Habitat Restoration Team volunteers play a vital role in restoring sensitive resources and protecting endangered species across the ridges and valleys.
ex.t: 栖息地修复团队的志愿者在恢复敏感资源、保护山脊与山谷间的濒危物种方面发挥着重要作用。

ex.s: Another issue is that the human brain is highly sensitive to wasted effort.
ex.t: 营员享受的师生比根据年龄组从1:4到1:7不等。

ex.s: We have to be very sensitive and work closely with the doctors and nurses, who keep us updated on each patient.
ex.t: 我们必须非常敏感，并与医生和护士密切合作，他们随时向我们报告每个病人的最新情况。

ex.s: While these same jokes might not be as funny to us now as they were then, their authors understood that humour could not only entertain but also throw new light on sensitive or emotive issues.
ex.t: 虽然这些笑话现在对我们来说可能不像当时那么有趣，但它们的作者明白，幽默不仅可以娱乐，还可以为敏感或情感问题带来新的启发。

ex.s: Background information “Eye of Heaven”, or the Five-hundred-metre Aperture Spherical Telescope (FAST), is the largest and most sensitive radio telescope in the world.
ex.t: 背景资料“天堂之眼”,即500米孔径球形望远镜，是世界上最大和最敏感的射电望远镜。

ex.s: Recently，I conceptualized a new approach to timekeeping that's connected to circumstances on our planet，conditions that might change as a result of global warming．We're now building a clock at the Anchorage Museum that reflects the total flow of several major Alaskan rivers，which are sensitive to local and global environmental changes．We've programmed it to match an atomic clock if the waterways continue to flow at their present rate．If the rivers run faster in the future on average，the clock will get ahead of standard time．If they run slower，you'll see the opposite effect．
ex.t: 最近，我构想了一种与地球环境状况相关的新计时方法，而这些状况可能因全球变暖而改变。我们现在正在安克雷奇博物馆建造一座时钟，它反映阿拉斯加几条主要河流的总流量，这些河流对地方和全球的环境变化十分敏感。我们已对它编程：如果水道继续以目前速率流动，它就与原子钟同步；如果未来河流平均流速加快，时钟就会跑在标准时间前面；如果变慢，则会出现相反效果。

defs.def: reacting quickly or more than usual to sth 敏感的；过敏的

ex.s: My senses of taste and smell became more sensitive, and I ate much more slowly, trying to guess what I was eating.
ex.t: 我对味道和嗅觉的感知变得更加敏感，我吃得更慢，试图猜测自己在吃什么。

defs.def: able to measure very small changes 灵敏的
